inputs.terrain_source: public: GIS-Steiermark ALS DGM 1 m (Gelaendehoehe Gesamtmodell)

materials.asphalt: inside the white lines (uv = ortho tile coordinates)
materials.kerb: regularised kerbs (kerbs.json regular_bands), red/white (uv = |n| in m, v in stripe blocks)
materials.kerb_yellow: regularised kerbs detected red/yellow (uv = |n| in m, v in blocks)
materials.verge: beyond the line: run-off, grass, skirt (uv = ortho tile coordinates)

ortho.attribution: Land Steiermark - GIS-Steiermark, Orthofotos Befliegung 2022-2024 (20 cm), CC BY 4.0 AT

ground.layout: ground/<i>_<j>[_lo].webp (lossless): RGB8 over the tile's orthophoto square (tile + margin), row 0 at +y, sampled with the orthophoto uv; R = render group (groups), G = distance of the texel centre to the nearest other group, d = dist_max_m G / 255; B = 0
attribution: Ground classes: derived from Land Steiermark - GIS-Steiermark, Orthofotos Befliegung 2022-2024 (20 cm), CC BY 4.0 AT and the LiDAR surface and terrain models (tools/track/ground.py)

trees.source: local maxima of surface model - terrain model (Land Steiermark - data.steiermark.gv.at (ALS Oberflaechenhoehe 1 m, Befliegung 2010, CC BY 4.0 AT); public: GIS-Steiermark ALS DGM 1 m (Gelaendehoehe Gesamtmodell)), checked in the orthophoto (Land Steiermark - GIS-Steiermark, Orthofotos Befliegung 2022-2024 (20 cm), CC BY 4.0 AT)

buildings.source: 2 m cells >= 2.5 m, not vegetation, of surface model - terrain model (Land Steiermark - data.steiermark.gv.at (ALS Oberflaechenhoehe 1 m, Befliegung 2010, CC BY 4.0 AT); public: GIS-Steiermark ALS DGM 1 m (Gelaendehoehe Gesamtmodell)), checked in the orthophoto (Land Steiermark - GIS-Steiermark, Orthofotos Befliegung 2022-2024 (20 cm), CC BY 4.0 AT)

lookup.equation: z(s, n) = z_c + n * dz_dn, linear between rows (asphalt plane; kerbs ignored)

attribution: Barriers, fences, buildings: (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0 (openstreetmap.org/copyright)

materials.t3_solid: armco, posts, walls, tyres, marshal posts, gantry, hoardings, board backs (vertex colour; alpha 1 steel, 0.5 paint, 0 concrete)
materials.t3_fence: chain-link mesh (uv = along m, height m; alpha texture)
materials.t3_board: braking board faces (uv = board atlas cell)

materials.t3_facade: walls (vertex colour x generic facade texture; uv = along the wall m, height m)
materials.t3_roof: roofs: in t3_facade with uv 0 (orthophoto colour)
materials.t3_seats: grandstand seating (uv = along m, rise m)

vegetation.source: local maxima of surface model - terrain model (Land Steiermark - data.steiermark.gv.at (ALS Oberflaechenhoehe 1 m, Befliegung 2010, CC BY 4.0 AT); public: GIS-Steiermark ALS DGM 1 m (Gelaendehoehe Gesamtmodell)), checked in the orthophoto (Land Steiermark - GIS-Steiermark, Orthofotos Befliegung 2022-2024 (20 cm), CC BY 4.0 AT)

materials.asphalt: pit lane and paved margins (uv = world m / 272)
materials.verge: grass cells of the pit grid

runoff_paint.layout: atlas RGB8: R = colour label (0 none, k = colours[k - 1]), G = distance to the nearest label edge (0..255 = 0..dist_max_m); glb uv = atlas texel coordinates / atlas size
